car-39-allocated-oxide-082cc2361b7e427d.rationale: Retain the named terbium oxide product and positive one-kg reference; reject the unrelated lithium-manganese-oxide heuristic. For each of the two actual source producers, every nonzero UUID/type/unit group is proportional to the neodymium-oxide output of the same rare-earth-carbonate joint process (136 groups for RoW, 38 for CN-FJ). Use those observed source allocation ratios to demand the complete native neodymium-oxide reference processing activity. This is an allocated-processing burden proxy, not a claim that neodymium oxide is the same chemical or a material conversion to another element. Preserve both original producer entries after this explicit reference-process scaling, and all four original freight quantities and marginal uncertainty without aggregation or renormalization. No new chemical-content, molar-mass, price, recovery or yield factor is inferred. The native Chinese process uses bastnasite-derived rare-earth co-production, whereas the source producers refine ion-adsorption-clay carbonates. The complete native processing inventory is a screening technology/ore proxy for both source regions; their actual route, mining/resource-depletion pattern, separation, purity, allocation, internal uncertainty and emissions are not reproduced. Source-specific observed allocation ratios do not validate native allocation prices, commodity performance or equivalent scores. Geographic production differences are replaced; original source quantities remain visible in the bindings. No standalone holmium/terbium mining inventory, avoided-metal credit or literal source-exchange omission is invented. Score effects, including element-specific resource limitations, are unquantified. Only the independently inspected source3.9 cut-off coordinate is newly approved. Preserve signed caller quantities, formulas, marginal uncertainty and separate purchases/emissions relative to the exact source reference. Native technology, allocation, geography, vintage, internal uncertainty and mapped-biosphere exclusions differ; score effects are unquantified. No new source omission, reverse route, other release or cross-system-model conversion is approved.
